memoryRule: a bounded pressure hold leaves the probe site local and changes three remote band geometries; accumulated load feeds the next revision
interactionRule: pointerdown/pointerup commits only inside a 140–720ms pressure window; Enter, Space, and the probe control use a deterministic 260ms probe; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
changedRule: The measured location is not the answer: a valid pressure changes a remote opened band, an inherited contour, and a shed band while carrying material load forward.
visibleConsequence: Actual Canvas band height, gap, bend, width, density, phase, and connecting membrane geometry change after a valid probe; weak and over-held pressure leave the membrane exact.
falsifier: Delete if pressure outside the calibration window commits, if the touched band changes directly, if remote roles are only UI, if later probes reset, if valid pressure does not change geometry, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v031 if the blind field reads as a generic chart, face, dashboard, or decorative raster instead of a singular diagnostic membrane.
representationRupture: folded WebGL volume, delegated SVG shell, and semantic DOM decision population -> one continuous p5.js Canvas 2D diagnostic membrane of scored bands
encounterRupture: traverse-and-release, boundary quorum, and single pulse -> bounded pressure hold whose local site is refused as the answer
temporalRupture: self-modifying fold grammar, edge delegation, and document-order crossing -> accumulated calibration load that changes remote geometry in later probes
mediumRupture: p5.js WEBGL, inline SVG, semantic DOM/CSS -> p5.js Canvas 2D raster field
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
